title: Booking history endpoint timing out for long-standing customers

agents.name: locator
agents.summary: Traced GET /api/bookings/history to routes/bookings.js:getBookingHistory — calls Booking.find({ accountId }) with no limit, offset, or pagination

agents.name: historian
agents.summary: 5 prose signals matched unbounded-resource (timed out, memory spiked, fine in staging, slow after data grew, loaded everything); confidence 0.92

agents.name: reproducer
agents.summary: Wrote failing test: seeds 4000-record stub, calls getBookingHistory, asserts response length <= 50; confirmed red — got 4000 records

agents.name: fixer
agents.summary: Added MAX_PAGE_SIZE=50 constant and limit parameter; Booking.find now receives { limit }; test green

agents.name: immunizer
agents.summary: Generated guardrail unbounded-resource-missing-limit; all 3 validate.js checks passed (matches pre-fix, not post-fix, 7 repo matches); also matches notifications.js (INC-009)

backtest.evidence: engine/backtest/validate.js: Check 1 PASSED (regex matches pre-fix), Check 2 PASSED (no match on post-fix), Check 3 PASSED (7 repo matches); detection also matches sandbox/services/notifications.js confirming generalisation to INC-009 pattern
